highlights.title: Live Updates: Rescuers Search for Missing and Stranded Under Threat of More Floods
highlights.summary: Officials said hundreds were killed in Nepal and Tibet, and more than 1,400 people are missing. Stunned witnesses described a torrent of debris and water carrying away villages in minutes.

highlights.title: El mundo de ayer
highlights.summary: Ucrania cumple 1.647 días de guerra, y asumes que lo único seguro en la vida es que no se puede dar nada por sentado

highlights.title: Collapsed glacier likely caused devastating Nepal-Tibet floods, scientists say
highlights.summary: Preliminary investigations by scientists have pointed to a collapsed glacier as the cause, highlighting the issue of rapidly melting Himalayan ice.

highlights.title: What we know about deadly Nepal-Tibet floods
highlights.summary: Hundreds have died or are missing in Wednesday's flooding and landslides on the border of Nepal and Tibet.
